review.rationale: Option A correctly refuses current CE-G13 execution due to material input-binding gaps (unsanitized public text, unordered request components, unbound S04/S05 dependencies, incomplete output allowlist). It preserves the immutable 28-file base package and its prior failed v0.1 review without mutation or retry. The bounded offline supplement defines four precise contracts: (1) sanitized public input bundle with exact UTF-8 text, hashes, and admission order; (2) model input envelopes binding exact request payloads, schemas, and upstream dependencies for all five sessions; (3) complete 26-file execution output allowlist with fail-closed rejection of extra/missing/modified artifacts; (4) outcome policy preserving FAIL_CLOSED and prohibiting repair. Security boundaries forbid secrets, credentials, hidden reasoning, and private metadata. Offline validation scope covers all 10 required checks including dependency binding, schema validity, and zero-effect constraints. Governance sequence enforces separation between recommendation, human decision, supplement preparation, validation, and execution readiness. Non-authorizations are comprehensive and authority boundaries are preserved. The 26-file count is independently verified: 1 README + 1 baseline receipt + 1 snapshot manifest + 1 retrieval receipt + 1 sanitized bundle + 5 envelopes + 5 request captures + 5 responses + 1 reuse validation + 1 technical receipt + 1 failure ledger + 1 composite result + 1 output manifest + 1 validation report = 26 files. No material inconsistencies detected.
